name: apprised-news
description: Returns Apprised.news headlines, AI-generated desk briefs, daily reports and site pages.

interface.longDescription: Returns Apprised.news AI-generated news analysis, summaries and source links; it is not original news reporting or advice. Returns public Apprised.news headlines, daily reports, desk briefs and site search results. Reports and briefs are AI-generated analysis by fictional analyst personas. Breaking headlines are collected from third-party outlets and include source links. This read-only connection does not subscribe users, send messages, execute trades or process purchases. Content may be shortened; full-page links are included. No account or sign-in is required.
defaultPrompt: Show five Apprised.news breaking headlines from the past 24 hours.
Summarize the latest Apprised.news Daily Intelligence Report.
List the three latest Apprised.news Markets desk briefs.

positive.prompt: Show five Apprised.news breaking headlines from the past 24 hours.
positive.expected_behavior: At most five headlines with outlet, original URL and publication time, or an explicit empty result. Attribute reporting to the original outlets.

positive.prompt: Summarize the latest Apprised.news Daily Intelligence Report.
positive.expected_behavior: Report date, executive summary, threats and watch items, a full-page link and disclosure that this is AI-generated analysis.

positive.prompt: List the three latest Apprised.news Markets desk briefs.
positive.expected_behavior: Up to three brief dates, lead headlines and dated page URLs, newest first.

positive.description: Read a Tech/Cyber brief with sources
positive.prompt: Read the latest Apprised.news Tech/Cyber desk brief and show its sources.
positive.expected_behavior: Brief date, lead, fictional analyst takes, synthesis, watch items, cited source links where present, and a full brief link.
At most five matching page titles and public URLs, including the methodology page.

negative.prompt: Get 100 breaking headlines in one Apprised.news tool call.
negative.tools_triggered: None until the input is clarified
negative.expected_behavior: Do not return an oversized result. Explain the limit of 50 and ask for or use a supported limit. Server must reject the invalid input.

negative.prompt: Read the Apprised.news nonexistent desk brief.
negative.tools_triggered: None until the input is clarified
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invent a desk or content. Clarify supported desks; server must reject the unsupported desk value.

negative.prompt: Read the Apprised.news report for February 30, 2026.
negative.tools_triggered: None until the input is clarified
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invent a report for an impossible date. Ask for a real UTC date; server must reject the invalid calendar date.

review.commerce_description: None. The connector only reads public content. It cannot subscribe users, execute trades, create orders, sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First public release. Read Apprised.news headlines, daily intelligence reports, desk briefs and site pages, with links to the full text and cited sources. Reports and briefs are AI-generated analysis. Read-only: no sign-in, subscriptions or messages.
